results.agency: Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development
eligible_industries: Grocery Stores and Fresh Food Retailers
results.program_description: The NourishMD Grant Program is a targeted investment designed to expand access to healthy and fresh foods in Maryland communities experiencing food insecurity. It provides direct grants to eligible for-profit or nonprofit food retailers located in areas with a high Fresh Food Gap Score, helping them purchase equipment, renovate facilities, expand inventory, and improve infrastructure for fresh food sales.

featured.featured_description: Grants of up to $150,000 to support capital-related needs for grocery stores and markets in areas with limited healthy food access.
